stemMd: What is the logical negation of: Every room has at least one window?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No room has more than one window.

options.label: C
options.textMd: At least one room has exactly one window.

options.label: D
options.textMd: At least one room has no windows.

explanationMd: To negate a universal claim, find at least one counterexample. A room without any window is exactly a counterexample to having at least one. The other rooms may have any number of windows.

distractorRationale.b: This is stronger than the negation.
distractorRationale.c: This is compatible with the original.
distractorRationale.a: This limits quantity rather than denying universality.
